The Subtask Name: Data Gathering for A Couch in New York Director

The Subtask Name: Final Comparison and Conclusion
Step Range: 22-22
The Oracle: Calculate ages at release and determine which film has the younger director based on gathered data.
Evidence: Step 22 (Planner) computes the ages (Akerman: 46; A.B. Raj: 43 or 47) and concludes that Kalippava has the younger director in the most likely scenario.
